verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a relay or CDN product, but the evidence pack documents no retention windows, cache expiry, or deletion controls in moq-relay. Self-hosting and end-to-end encryption are adjacent privacy controls, not retention or deletion settings. SageOx's S3 archiver is a user-built consumer, not a capability of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
